artworks.title: Homestead Steelworks, Homestead, Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial landscape with factories emitting smoke. The factories are lined up in the center of the image. In the background, there are hills. Near the factories, there are residential buildings with small houses. The image is in sepia tones, giving it a historical look.

artworks.title: Diamond River Canyon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The photograph shows the view from the bottom of a narrow canyon, looking up at towering rock walls. The horizon is not visible, as the cliffs extend vertically out of the frame. The image emphasizes the texture and detail of the rock surfaces, showcasing their rough and craggy nature. The color palette is earthy, with shades of brown and beige. A stream trickles over stones near the viewer, winding through the canyon. In the distance, the water leads deeper into the canyon where sunlight highlights the walls.

artworks.title: Turner Family Garden, Woburn, Massachusetts
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a park-like area from a slightly elevated perspective. Trees with elongated shadows cover the grassy ground. A man and a small child walk hand in hand. In the distance, a person sits on a bench partially hidden by trees. The horizon is blocked by dense foliage, with hints of a building visible. The scene is in sepia tone, giving it a vintage look. The textures have a brushstroke-like quality.

artworks.title: Enchanted Mesa, Acoma, New Mexico
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned view of a pueblo village from an elevated perspective. There are flat-roofed adobe houses with wooden ladders leaning against the walls. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, meeting the sky with scattered clouds. A flat-topped mesa stands prominently in the background. The terrain looks arid and rugged with some vegetation, leading towards distant mesas and plateaus. The color palette is warm with sepia tones, creating an antique atmosphere.

artworks.title: View Near Chipigana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The photograph depicts a dense section of a forest filled with various trees and lush undergrowth. The canopy of leaves and tree trunks fills the entire vertical space. The trees have visible bark texture and cast shadows on the leafy ground, which is cluttered with leaves and branches. The image has a sepia or monochrome tone, with shades of brown and beige dominating the scene. The interplay of light and shadow creates a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Mirror Lake, Yosemite Valley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a lake reflecting trees and mountains. The viewpoint is near the water, capturing nearby foliage and distant mountains. The horizon shows tall trees against a clear sky. The lake acts as a mirror, reflecting the scenery. The color palette is mostly sepia tones. Details include plants and grasses near the water’s edge.

artworks.title: Wall in the Grand Canyon—Colorado River
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a cliff face viewed from a riverbank. The cliff rises steeply from the water, with a group of people and a small boat nearby. The rock surface is textured and layered, showing striations. The color palette includes earthy tones of brown and tan, with light and shadow enhancing the rugged appearance of the cliff.

artworks.title: Black Canyon, Colorado River, Looking Below from Big Horn Camp, #4
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a rugged landscape with large rock formations dominating the right side. The horizon is situated in the upper third of the image, mostly obscured by towering cliffs. The rock surfaces rise steeply from the water, with varied tones. The water is still, mirroring the cliffs and enhancing the vertical lines. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. In the distance, the cliffs continue, interspersed with shadows.

artworks.title: Landscape with Haystacks
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon, with scattered trees and distant hills, is visible below the midpoint. Numerous haystacks are lined in rows across a vast field, along with a horse-drawn cart and figures tending the field. A wooden fence runs horizontally across the scene, surrounded by large trees. The image is monochromatic, with soft gray tones. Wispy clouds are dispersed against a pale sky.

artworks.title: A Morning by the Brook, near Lake Waramaug, Connecticut
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a nature scene captured from a ground-level perspective, featuring trees obstructing the horizon and a rustic wooden bridge in the distance. The trees frame the scene, creating light and shadow patterns. The color scheme is primarily sepia tones. A stream flows in the foreground, with a man standing by it holding a basket. Various vegetation lines the water's edge.

artworks.title: Camp Tye, Virginia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image displays an elevated outdoor camping scene with a group of men. There is a cooking area with a fire and cooking equipment. Two men are at the campsite, one possibly tending to the fire and the other next to a stick structure. There is a canvas tent with camping gear and a cot. The camp is surrounded by vegetation and trees. The image is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Dell
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with a stream running diagonally from the bottom left corner towards the center. Trees surround the scene, with their foliage visible. The horizon is obscured by trees that continue into the distance, where a structure can be slightly seen among the trees. The water reflects the trees near us. The image has a monochromatic sepia tone, enhancing the natural textures and details. The style is photographic, with detailed and realistic rendering.

artworks.title: Dodge’s Bluff, Canyon of Grand River
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of railway tracks curving to the right beside a river. The tracks are flanked by rocky terrain, with a large rock face on the left. In the distance, rugged cliffs and rock formations are visible against a clear sky. The perspective is slightly angled, giving a sense of standing at the edge of the tracks. The color palette is composed of sepia tones, creating a warm and nostalgic atmosphere. Light and shadow highlight the texture of the rocks. The image has a classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: Scene on Stella Lake, Wawona Station
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a still body of water with a small rowboat occupied by five people. Tall trees grow alongside the bank, with their reflections in the water. A sliver of grassy land and a tree trunk are visible on the right side. The horizon is obscured by dense trees blending into the background. The image has a nostalgic, sepia-toned palette. The lighting is soft, creating gentle shadows in the scene.

artworks.title: A Mexican Family Group, Mission San Juan Capistrano, California
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: A group of ten people, including men, women, and children, are in front of a rustic adobe house with a shingle roof. The adults are dressed in early 1900s attire, with long skirts and blouses for the women and suits or vests for the men. The children are dressed simply, with some wearing hats. One woman with braids is seated on a wooden bench, and a man in a suit and hat stands behind two seated women. Some children are seated on the ground. Several women wear necklaces. The background shows an open field with sparse vegetation, a few structures, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Man Shoveling Corn near Andrews, North Carolina
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man captured from head to knees, standing on a wooden cart. His body is slightly bent forward, and he is holding a long-handled tool or stick in his right hand, which rests on the edge of the cart. The man has short light-colored hair and wears a short-sleeved, dark shirt and light-colored pants. In the background, there is a wooden structure, likely a shed or barn, with visible planks on the roof. Surrounding the man are overgrown plants or shrubs near the cart, contributing to the rural atmosphere. The image is rendered in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Untitled (Fishing Nets)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a dockside scene with a fisherman rowing a boat. There is a wooden structure with hanging fishing nets. The nets cast shadows on the wooden planks. In the background, there is a rustic building with a slightly angled roofline. The overall scene has soft, sepia-toned hues and a blurred, painterly effect.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Women in a Boat
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts two women seated in a striped rowboat. They have distinctively styled hair with dark hats. The women wear long-sleeved, high-collared dresses with embroidered details. They are set against a painted backdrop of a scenic landscape with mountains and greenery by a lake.

artworks.title: Portrait of Three Hunters, Dogs and Game
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Three men are depicted in full-body view. The man on the left is kneeling, holding a firearm, and wearing a cap and ragged coat. His facial features include a mustache. The man in the middle stands confidently, holding a rifle, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, with a full mustache and goatee. The man on the right kneels, also holding a firearm, with a shorter brimmed hat and a clean-shaven face. They are dressed in outdoor clothing, possibly for hunting. Several birds are suspended from a line around them, and two hunting dogs are at their feet. The backdrop suggests a painted outdoor scene.

artworks.title: Members of the Small Point Association, Maine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Four men are depicted in the image. The man on the left is standing upright and holds several birds and a fish. Next to him, an older man is sitting with a relaxed posture. The third man is standing behind the seated man, holding a broom-like object. The man on the right is seated with a rifle across his lap. The background shows a plain wall with a faint architectural design.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Sleigh Makers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: Two men stand outdoors beside a vintage sleigh. Both are shown in full body, one leaning on the sleigh to the right and the other standing to the left with a hand on his hip. The man on the right has distinct facial features with a clean-shaven face and wears a dark vest over a white long-sleeve shirt, paired with dark pants and a wide-brimmed hat. The man on the left also wears a similar hat and is dressed in a dark vest over a long-sleeved shirt, covered with a striped apron. The sleigh, prominently in the center, appears ornate with curved metal ski-like runners. The ground is covered with patches of snow, and the background features a wooden structure with a vertically paneled siding. The image is framed with an ornate gold and red border.

artworks.title: Lower Multnomah Falls, Columbia River
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing down a cliff surrounded by vegetation. The viewpoint is face-on, highlighting the vertical descent of the waterfall as it drops from the top of the rocky wall into a pool. The horizon appears high in the frame, above the waterfall, with dense greenery. The waterfall is the main focus, contrasting against the rough cliffs. The color scheme is monochromatic, ranging from dark shadows in the stone to lighter areas where the water reflects light. Nearby, there are smooth rocks and pebbles on the ground, along with branches and logs, indicating receded water or a long exposure capturing the stream's flow.

artworks.title: Seal Point, Farallon Islands, Pacific Ocean
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a rocky coastal scene filled with a large group of seals. The seals are seen interacting and lounging on the rocks. The background shows a subtle horizon where the ocean meets the sky. The photograph is sharp and focused, capturing the textures of the rocks and seals. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving the image a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Putting in Elevator, Golden Feather, Oroville
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the UBS Art Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on a rock overlooking a mining area in rocky terrain. A wooden structure and scattered mining equipment are visible, with a sloping track and a row of ore carts. Distant hills merge with the sky on the high horizon. The photo has a sepia tone, typical of early photographic techniques, and features a palette of browns and tans matching the earth and rocks, with the sky in a golden hue.
